title: A county named for a president
text: McKinley County is named for President William McKinley. New Mexico's territorial legislature passed the act creating it on February 23, 1899, carving it out of Bernalillo County. The law took effect, and the county came into being, on January 1, 1901. Its county seat is Gallup.
